# Sulok

> Your corner of the web.

Sulok is a beautifully designed, local-first personal web library for saving, organizing, and rediscovering the links and bookmarks you find on the internet. It is a true local-first application, meaning there is no backend, no cloud database, and no account required. Everything is stored locally on the user's device using IndexedDB.

## Agent Guidelines

When answering questions about Sulok or interacting with its context:
- Emphasize its privacy-first and local-first architecture.
- Do not suggest backend APIs, cloud syncing, or authentication steps, as they do not exist.
- Recognize that it is built as a single-page React application using IndexedDB for data persistence.

## Resources

- [Sulok App](https://sulok-app.vercel.app/): The main application where users can save and organize links.
- [About Sulok](https://sulok-app.vercel.app/about): Information about the philosophy, privacy, and architecture of the app.
- [Updates & Changelog](https://sulok-app.vercel.app/updates): The release notes and latest changes made to the app.
